paragraphs: QQQ is +1.30% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is +14/100 (Mixed / Neutral). Score path: open +5 → now +14 (improved 9 points).

The main live drivers are Rates are a headwind: the 10Y is 5.115%, +3.2 bp since the opening snapshot. The 2Y rate signal is a headwind: 4.797% (+1.0 bp vs prev close). Semiconductors are supportive: Live · SOX +2.27% | Nasdaq +1.25% | SOX vs Nasdaq +1.02 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq +1.12 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq +0.87 pp.
The upside move is broadly confirmed by Nasdaq internals (semiconductors positive, mega-caps positive, breadth mixed).
